question: Janmashtami is a Hindu festival that celebrates the birth (janma) of the god, Krishna on the eighth (ashtami) day of the dark fortnight of the Hindu month of _____________.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Bhadrapada**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Janmashtami** is a significant Hindu festival celebrating the birth of Lord Krishna.
 
• This celebration occurs on the eighth (ashtami) day of the dark fortnight in the Hindu month of **Bhadrapada**.
 
• Lord Krishna is one of the most revered deities in Hinduism, known for his teachings in the Bhagavad Gita.
 
• Devotees observe fasting, sing devotional songs, and enact plays depicting Krishna's life during the festival.
 
• The festival is celebrated with great enthusiasm across India and in Hindu communities worldwide.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Lord Krishna** was born in Mathura, and his birthplace is a major pilgrimage site during Janmashtami.
 
• The festival is also known as **Gokulashtami** in some regions.
 
• Krishna's birth is celebrated at midnight, the time when it is believed he was born.
 
• Various rituals include **Rasa Lila** (dramatic enactments of Krishna's life) and **Dahi Handi** (breaking of the pot filled with curd) which are popular in Maharashtra.
 
• Janmashtami is also an occasion to reflect on the teachings of Krishna, especially those found in the **Bhagavad Gita**.
